workflows.name: Plan an event: pick a venue, a caterer and flowers, then draft the proposal email
steps: In the Peerspace tab, type "{event}" in What are you planning?, type {city} in Where? and pick it from the list, then click Search
Open the first venue that fits {guests} guests and note its name and hourly price. Do not click Reserve or Request
Switch to the ezCater tab, type {city} as the delivery address and pick it, set the date to {date}, then search for "{cuisine}"
Open the first caterer and note its name and minimum order. Do not add anything to the cart
Switch to the 1-800-Flowers tab, search "{flowers}", open the first product and note its name and price. Do not add it to the cart
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {contact}@example.com, click Subject and type "{event} on {date}: venue, food, flowers"
Click Body and type "Hi {contact}, for {guests} guests: venue <name> (<price>/h), catering <caterer> (min <amount>), flowers <product> (<price>)." Do not click Send. Click Discard

workflows.name: Find a recent arXiv paper on a topic and check its citations on Semantic Scholar
steps: In the arXiv tab, click Advanced Search, type "{topic}" in the search term field
Under Subject tick {category}, under Date choose Specific year and type {year}, then click Search
Open the first result and note its title and first author
Open a new tab, go to semanticscholar.org, search for that title and open the matching paper; read its citation count
Close the Semantic Scholar tab, switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{topic} ({year}): <title> by <first author>, <N> citations" and press Enter

workflows.name: Look up a Supreme Court case on CourtListener and the related statute on Cornell LII
steps: In the CourtListener tab, click the search box, type "{case}" and press Enter
Open the matching Supreme Court opinion and note its citation (like 585 U.S. 296) and date filed
Open a new tab, go to law.cornell.edu, search "{statute}" with the site's search and open the statute page
Note the section heading, then close the tab
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{case}: <citation>, decided <date>. See {statute} (<heading>)" and press Enter

noise.description: Open a new tab, go to theguardian.com, scroll through the headlines, open one story, skim it, close the tab
Open a new tab, go to weather.com, search the forecast for Chicago, look at it, close the tab
Abandoned attempt: in the 1-800-Flowers tab, search "tulips", scroll the results, then give up without opening any
Wander: click through the Notes, Mail and arXiv tabs without doing anything, scroll the Notes list
Open a new tab, go to en.wikipedia.org, click Random article in the menu, skim it, close the tab
